recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered composition featuring a descending sequence of a male figure's head and shoulders, set against a blue-to-sunset gradient background divided by horizontal scan lines, anchored by a high-contrast black and white silhouette of the London skyline.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal progression of the subject from top-center to mid-left
Contrast between the vibrant blue upper half and the stark monochrome skyline base
Integration of custom script typography with a triple-line speed-trail motif
Horizontal banding creating a rhythmic, scan-line texture across the entire image
coreInvariants: Descending scale of the repeated subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary subject is largest at the top right-center, decreasing in scale as it repeats down a diagonal path toward the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The heavy, black silhouette of Tower Bridge and the London skyline at the bottom edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal line of the subject's descent, then moves right across the skyline to the vertical Big Ben tower.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant blue space in the center-right provides breathing room for the secondary typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep cobalt blue transitioning into a pale lavender and orange sunset gradient.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Solid black for the skyline and subject outlines.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White for the high-contrast highlights and primary graphic lines.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the blue sky contrasting with the zero-saturation black and white base.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to blue, orange, black, and white
Avoid complex photographic textures in the skyline

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Round, cursive script with heavy weight and interlocking loops.
letterConstructionRules: Triple-line stroke following the baseline and extending into a speed trail
High-contrast white fill with thick black outlines
Exaggerated swashes on the first and last letters
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'J' and 'L' are connected by a continuous triple-line underline
Descenders are truncated to sit on the graphic line
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a heavy, illustrative script and a clean, geometric sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the geometric 70s feel for secondary text
The primary logo requires bespoke multi-line construction

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a blue-to-orange sunset sky with horizontal scan-line banding. At the bottom, place a high-contrast black and white silhouette of the London skyline including Tower Bridge and Big Ben. Add a sequence of a man's head and shoulders descending diagonally from top-center to mid-left, decreasing in size.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a custom script title in the top right with a triple-line underline that extends across the image. Place secondary sans-serif text in white in the mid-right negative space.

verificationChecks: Is the skyline strictly black and white?
Are the horizontal scan lines visible across the sky?
Does the subject repeat in a clear diagonal descent?
Is the primary text underlined by three parallel lines?

adjustableVariables: Subject matter of the repeated figure
Primary sky color (e.g., purple to pink)

mustAchieve: Clear hierarchy between script and sans-serif

postGenerationChecks: Check for triple-line consistency in the graphic element
Ensure the skyline silhouette is sharp and not muddy
Verify the gradient bands are horizontal and evenly spaced
Confirm the subject's scale decreases consistently
recipe.reuseFormula: Diagonal subject progression + Horizontal scan-line gradient + High-contrast architectural silhouette + Multi-line script typography.
